mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are decreasing, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS is decreasing and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which is a negative signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 > 12-month MA and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
